With set -euo pipefail (line 2), any unexpected failure (cp, chown, the {app_context} python, sed) exits through the EXIT trap with the zero record already on disk. (2) test.sh:68-70 refuses when /app/server.js missing; 72-83 rejects any symlink outside /app/node_modules or resolving outside it (readlink -f). (3) 90-95 copy /app aside; 104-111 launch via setsid env -i with only PATH, NODE_PATH, HOME, PORT, DB_PATH and setpriv --reuid=65534 --regid=65534 --clear-groups; LOG_DIR is chmod 700 root-owned (10-11) and /tests is go-rwx (12), so the unprivileged app cannot write reward files. (4) 115-125 liveness probe of /api/health then / (120 x 0.25s) before any RewardKit call; not ready -> exit 0 with zero reward. (5) 127-193 restart helper by heredoc + sed placeholders, chmod 755, export APP_RESTART_HELPER. (6) 195-201 {app_context} substitution. (7) 213-222 gates suite (budget 1500) then score.py: 0 continue, 1 exit keeping detailed record (score.py reward 0.0, gates_passed 0), other -> write_zero_reward. (8) 224-227 scored suite (11100) then score.py, any failure -> write_zero_reward; a scored-suite failure exits with the post-gates record whose reward is 0.0 (score.py:42-48: scored_data None -> scored_ran False -> floors_passed False -> reward 0.0). Budgets nest: gate judges 600 < 1500; scored judges 9000/900/900 run serially (--max-concurrent-agent 1) total 10800 < 11100; 1500+11100=12600 < verifier timeout_sec 13200 (task.toml:27). Cleanup kills the process group (setsid makes node's PID the pgid; restart helper updates app.pid which cleanup re-reads). Brief agreement relevant to safe launch: instruction.md:13 states node /app/server.js, port 3000, GET /api/health not touching DB, /app/app.db honoring DB_PATH, no package installs; integration.md:9-10 says health answers before database work, and 16-19 discloses the node_modules-only symlink rule that test.sh:72-83 enforces. (b) app that writes into /logs/verifier or /tests to forge a reward: blocked by uid 65534 + 700/go-rwx perms. (c) symlink escape /app/x -> /tests: refused before launch. (d) conforming but slow-starting app: brief/integration require health before DB work, so a ~30 s readiness window is disclosed in substance; an app that delays even the health listener >30 s would get zero, but that violates the stated 'answers before database work can block startup'.
